findings.reproduction: After Wrap, alter h.Planes[0][0], replace h.Planes[1] with empty array, change h.Route[0]/h.Chip[0]. Native assertion Result snapshots protect verified outputs returned False; exported pixels changed and replacement could make export fail.
findings.fix: Defensive result snapshots, cloned input and single complete-result publication; concurrent Wrap encodes its own snapshot.
findings.regression: Native mutation assertions and 128 parallel Wrap calls pass.

findings.reproduction: Pillow read C# byte TIFF ResolutionUnit=2 (INCH), X/YResolution=3175/1, while JS byte planes are uncalibrated. These LUT output bytes/route IDs have no measured physical pixel calibration.
findings.fix: ResolutionUnit=1 (NONE), X/YResolution=1/1; explicit top-left orientation, planar layout and unsigned integer sample format.
findings.regression: Pillow verifies uncalibrated metadata and all 4,096 pixels in each of 35 C# and 35 JS files.

additionalHardening: ArgumentNullException names ram; length exceptions name ram; TIFF index validated consistently before unsampled state.
limitations: Execution was Windows x64 .NET, not native ARM64 .NET or physical silicon.
Browser application does not compile or invoke C#; native source stays reference/test material.
